best_moment.what: The Counter: I told them exactly why the plan would fail, and the game later confirmed it raised my hidden ceiling to Deputy Secretary. Honesty paid off in a way I could see.

worst_moment.what: Appraisal chat with only one option, and my standing fell despite outstanding appraisals. The late years gave me one button and no drama, so I was just tapping.

skip_year.why: One choice, STAND dropping for no clear reason, and nothing happening. It felt like filler right before the end.

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y27 told them exactly why it would fail (The Counter)
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: The ending card named it as the year my ceiling rose to Deputy Secretary

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y31 confessed to the Telegram leak and waited out the inquiry
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: Only showed up as an exposure score peaking at 46 and a note that everything surfaces at 85, so no real payoff

callbacks_noticed.earlier_choice: Y3 laughed along when the Director called the system a joke; Y10 asked a friend for BTO inside info; Y32 kept the consultancy letter; Y35 told the adviser about politics
callbacks_noticed.came_back_as: I never saw any of these return before I retired

answer.held_back_by: Probably my hidden ceiling, which was set early and only moved once, plus the slow STAND decline that I could not explain. I also never got invited into politics, so maybe the game wanted something from me that I never worked out.
answer.ending_fair_why: I got to the very top with full reputation, integrity and competence, so the result is fine. But so many threads I was told might come back never did, and the card's 'at 85 everything surfaces' is a threat for a life I will not get to play. It felt like it ended before the payoff.
answer.chase_next: The politics route, to find out whether the invitation ever comes and where it leads. I spent decades waiting on it and never saw it, so I want to see it.
answer.play_again_why: Not right now. The early and mid career had good moments, but the last decade thinned out into single options. I would come back once I had a theory about how to trigger the callbacks.

tone_breaks.line: No street is named after you and none ever will be, which is rather the point.
tone_breaks.note: A little knowing nudge at the reader. It is fine, but it does lean on a smirk.
Teases a payoff that the game ends before delivering, and I did not understand what it refers to.

answer.title_fit_why: The game is about being tested, appraised and slowly proven, not about salary. 'Minister Salary' sounds like a joke about money, but the money was the least interesting part.
